statement: I recomputed the six authority-artifact digests after the rename; five moved (product, architecture, threat-model, verification, cli) and source-request did not, because it never named the project. The substitution was a single case-preserving word mapping applied identically to the product, the specification and the acceptance suite. Symmetry is the argument that it preserves semantics; the judged run is the proof.
authority_effect: Records the Validator's recomputation. Certification independence is not established: the Validator authored product code from 2026-09-08 by founder direction.
provenance: Validator computation over the working tree; no external cryptographic signature is claimed.
